title: RepoAssure Representative Multi-Mode Acceptance Target and Execution Authorization Decision Recording v0.1
objective: Record explicit target selection and execution decisions for the Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent representative acceptance lanes without inventing targets, reusing stale authorization, or executing any target.
acceptance: Record one explicit approve_execution, reject, or defer decision for each of Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent.

For every approve_execution decision, record the exact target or fixture, revision or digest, provenance and license review, privacy and secret review, command envelope, network and installation boundary, isolated workspace, allowed outputs, stop conditions, and cleanup plan.
Keep any lane with missing target, revision, provenance, privacy, reproducibility, or command-boundary evidence deferred.
Do not infer approval from Goal execution authorization or prior target-testing authorization.

Do not acquire, install, start, execute, analyze, or write any target; do not publish, deploy, launch, modify repository controls, contact anyone, change pricing or spend, change detector or acceptance behavior, or infer final product acceptance.
